en.headline: Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival returns to Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s themed race night at Happy Valley Racecourse features live music, special drinks and food from 6pm, with public enclosure entry at HK$10.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival continues this evening at Happy Valley Racecourse. The November series pairs evening racing with live performances and a selection of food and drinks in the Beer Garden.

Tonight’s programme starts at 6pm. International and local acts have been scheduled across the race nights; organisers said the Beer Garden menu includes themed cocktails inspired by local horses alongside other drinks and bites.

Public enclosure admission is HK$10, payable by Octopus at the entrance. Visitors holding a valid travel document can enter free. Entrants must be aged 18 or above. The same format runs on other Wednesdays this month.
The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists the event among its current offerings. Racegoers can collect stamps at participating stalls with a Discovery Passport for small rewards.

zh.headline: 跑馬地Happy Wednesday音樂美食節今晚舉行
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會跑馬地馬場主題賽馬夜今晚六時開始，啤酒園有現場音樂、特色飲品及美食，公眾席入場費10元。
body: 香港賽馬會的Happy Wednesday音樂美食節今晚在跑馬地馬場繼續。十一月的系列活動把夜間賽事與現場表演、啤酒園美食飲品結合。
今晚節目由下午六時開始。賽馬夜安排國際及本地表演者；主辦方表示啤酒園菜單包括以本地賽駒為靈感的主題雞尾酒及其他小食。
公眾席入場費10元，可於入口以八達通繳付。持有效旅遊證件的訪港旅客免費入場。入場人士須年滿18歲。本月其他周三亦有相同安排。
香港旅遊發展局將活動列為現時推介項目。入場人士可領取探索護照，於參與攤位蓋章換取小獎賞。
